svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Devcontainer image and runtime
svg.desc: The image build on the left, what it installs, and what runs inside the container on the right. The hero edges are the two places this change establishes a single integration point: root-owned agent hook configs calling osf, and the git wrapper forcing the hooks path.
